facts.business: Bhatia Colour Chem Limited is engaged in the trading and manufacturing of textile chemicals, dyes, auxiliaries, plastic granules, and value-added printing products such as foil binders, glitter powder, and textile printing dyes.
key_risks: Stringent environmental regulations leading to higher operational costs and capital investment in ETPs/ZLD
Volatility in raw material prices due to reliance on petrochemical-based inputs
Intense competition from domestic and international players including Chinese suppliers
Customer consolidation reducing leverage for chemical manufacturers
Global economic uncertainty impacting textile exports
Currency fluctuations affecting cost structures and profitability
Health and safety risks from handling hazardous chemicals
facts.related_party_note: The company has provided loans or advances in the nature of loans to other parties (firm) with an outstanding balance of Rs. 350.00 lakhs as at March 31, 2026.
